//: Every Development profile pins ConnectionStrings__Default to the LOCAL dev
database. This machine carries a User-level ConnectionStrings__Default
environment variable pointing at a remote host, required by a different
application; environment variables outrank user-secrets in this project's
precedence chain (docs/configuration.md), so without this pin a plain
`dotnet run` drives that remote database instead of LAPTOP-CSB3KO3E.
launchSettings wins over the machine env var because dotnet run applies
the profile's variables to the child process.
Trusted_Connection only - this file is tracked in git and must never carry
a password. Scripted runs do not read launchSettings at all, so they pin
the same value themselves (see tools/run-smokes.ps1), and Program.cs
refuses to start in Development against anything but this database.
